package com.synexia.common.collections;

import com.sun.management.ThreadMXBean;
import com.synexia.primitives.PrimitiveIndexView;
import com.synexia.primitives.PrimitiveKind;
import com.synexia.primitives.PrimitiveSoaStore;
import java.lang.management.ManagementFactory;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.NavigableSet;
import java.util.SortedMap;
import java.util.TreeMap;
import java.util.TreeSet;

/** Bounded allocation diagnostic, not a throughput benchmark or universal performance gate. */
public final class M3WrapperAllocationProbe {
    private static volatile Object objectSink;
    private static volatile boolean booleanSink;

    private M3WrapperAllocationProbe() { }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        if (!(ManagementFactory.getThreadMXBean() instanceof ThreadMXBean bean)
                || !bean.isThreadAllocatedMemorySupported()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("thread allocation counters unavailable");
        }
        if (!bean.isThreadAllocatedMemoryEnabled()) bean.setThreadAllocatedMemoryEnabled(true);
        long threadId = Thread.currentThread().threadId();
        List<Scenario> scenarios = scenarios();
        System.out.println("M3WrapperAllocationProbe runtime=" + System.getProperty("java.runtime.version")
                + " vm=" + System.getProperty("java.vm.name")
                + " flags=" + ManagementFactory.getRuntimeMXBean().getInputArguments());
        System.out.println("scenario,round,operations,allocatedBytes,bytesPerOperation");
        for (Scenario scenario : scenarios) {
            run(scenario.operation(), scenario.warmups());
            for (int round = 0; round < 5; round++) {
                long before = bean.getThreadAllocatedBytes(threadId);
                run(scenario.operation(), scenario.iterations());
                long allocated = bean.getThreadAllocatedBytes(threadId) - before;
                if (allocated < 0) throw new IllegalStateException("invalid allocation counter");
                System.out.println(scenario.name() + "," + round + "," + scenario.iterations()
                        + "," + allocated + "," + ((double) allocated / scenario.iterations()));
            }
        }
    }

    private static List<Scenario> scenarios() {
        List<Scenario> scenarios = new ArrayList<>();
        TreeSet<Integer> sourceSet = new TreeSet<>();
        TreeMap<Integer, Integer> sourceMap = new TreeMap<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
            sourceSet.add(i);
            sourceMap.put(i, i);
        }
        NavigableSet<Integer> set = M3FilteredViews.filter(sourceSet, value -> (value & 1) == 0);
        SortedMap<Integer, Integer> map = M3FilteredViews.filterEntries(
                (SortedMap<Integer, Integer>) sourceMap, (key, value) -> (key & 7) == 3);
        // Match the preserved delegation path and force the public cursor to escape.
        scenarios.add(new Scenario("descendingIterator", () -> objectSink = set.descendingIterator(),
                100000, 200000));
        scenarios.add(new Scenario("sortedMapIsEmpty", () -> booleanSink = map.isEmpty(),
                100000, 200000));
        for (int size : new int[] {0, 1024}) {
            PrimitiveSoaStore store = new PrimitiveSoaStore(Math.max(1, size),
                    PrimitiveSoaStore.STATE_BYTES, PrimitiveKind.LONG);
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) store.appendRow(new long[] {i}, (byte) (i & 1), 0L);
            PrimitiveIndexView view = PrimitiveIndexView.identity(store);
            scenarios.add(new Scenario("filterLaneAll_" + size,
                    () -> objectSink = view.filterLane(0, bits -> true), 10000, 2000));
            scenarios.add(new Scenario("filterLaneHalf_" + size,
                    () -> objectSink = view.filterLane(0, bits -> (bits & 1L) == 0L), 10000, 2000));
            scenarios.add(new Scenario("filterMaskAll_" + size,
                    () -> objectSink = view.filterStateMask(0), 10000, 2000));
            scenarios.add(new Scenario("filterMaskHalf_" + size,
                    () -> objectSink = view.filterStateMask(1), 10000, 2000));
        }
        return scenarios;
    }

    private static void run(Runnable operation, int repetitions) {
        for (int i = 0; i < repetitions; i++) operation.run();
    }

    private record Scenario(String name, Runnable operation, int warmups, int iterations) { }
}
